Headquarters: San Francisco, California; USA, Remote

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What's the opportunity? 

Are you ready to lead the charge in AI-driven customer service? As an Enterprise Account Executive focused on selling Fin, our cutting-edge AI agent, you’ll play a pivotal role in revolutionizing how enterprises scale customer support. Fin leverages advanced artificial intelligence to deliver seamless, efficient, and intelligent support experiences, making it a game-changer for businesses worldwide.

This is your chance to join a world-class sales team, driving the upmarket growth of a transformative AI solution. At Fin, we don’t just sell products; we empower businesses to reimagine their customer support strategies. If you’re looking for ownership, creativity, and the opportunity to lead in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What will I be doing? 

• Champion AI transformation: Drive the adoption of Fin, helping enterprise clients unlock the power of AI to automate and scale their support operations.

• Full-cycle sales ownership: Manage the entire sales process—from prospecting to close—with a consultative and tailored approach.

• Customer advocate: Act as the voice of the customer, collaborating with Product, Marketing, and other teams to refine and enhance the AI-agent offering.

• Tailored AI demonstrations: Create and deliver compelling, customized demos that showcase the unique value of Fin as an AI agent.

• Revenue-focused: Provide timely, accurate forecasts and ensure clear visibility into your sales pipeline and performance.

• Team growth: Contribute to the overall success of the sales team by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and leading innovative projects to up-level the group.

What skills do I need? 

• Proven success: 8+ years of experience as an Account Executive, with at least 3 years selling SaaS solutions to enterprise clients.

• Hunter mentality: Proven track record of outbounding and creating the majority of your pipeline and revenue. 

• AI expertise: Familiarity with AI-powered solutions, customer engagement tools, or support automation products is a strong advantage.

• Quota achiever: Demonstrated ability to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Strategic communicator: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex AI solutions.

• Solution-focused: Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing opportunities across diverse industries.

• Customer-centric mindset: Skilled at building trust and creating value in competitive sales landscapes.

• Growth-oriented: Displays intellectual curiosity, ambition, and a commitment to personal and team development

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The OTE salary range for candidates is $351,000 to $390,000 for the San Francisco Bay Area and New York, $315,000 to $351,000 in Washington and Chicago, $298,350 to $331,500 in Colorado. Actual OTE pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-account-executive-enterprise

Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Vice President, Investment Banking (IB) role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to play a key role in execution of complex middle-market transactions while leveraging integrated capabilities across practice lines – a differentiated model aimed to delivery comprehensive solutions to clients. As a key member of the Investment Banking team, this Vice President will manage critical transaction workstreams across mergers and acquisitions, capital advisory, restructurings, special situations and other strategic advisory engagements. This Vice President will report to local Investment Banking leadership while partnering closely with U.S.-based bankers and clients. If you thrive in a high-performance culture and want to help build the future of a rapidly growing advisory platform, this is the right role for you.

Responsibilities

• Partner with senior team members across practice lines to lead live M&A transaction, capital raise, recapitalization, restructuring and special situations engagement execution
• Manage the preparation and review of complex financial models, valuation analyses and transaction materials
• Oversee the development of client deliverables including teasers, confidential information presentations, management presentations, process letters and board materials
• Evaluate strategic alternatives and capital structure solutions for companies facing operational or financial challenges
• Coordinate due diligence processes, data room management and transaction timelines
• Work directly with U.S.-based bankers to drive day-to-day transaction execution and ensure timely client work product delivery
• Support interactions with clients, private equity sponsors, lenders, investors, legal counsel and other transaction participants
• Coordinate with lenders, investors, legal advisors and other stakeholders throughout restructuring and special situations processes
• Manage and mentor Associates, providing technical guidance, quality control and professional development support
• Support the adoption of AI tools and automation capabilities across the IB team, partnering with the Innovation and AI Solutions group to modernize investment banking processes and drive efficiencies
• Support business development initiatives through research, pitch preparation, market analysis and relationship maintenance with existing clients Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
• Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
• Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
• Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon or Mumbai
• Six plus years of experience at a top-tier investment bank serving U.S.-based clients and deal teams
• Strong financial modeling skills and deep understanding of corporate finance and valuation methodologies including DCF, LBO, merger modeling, trading and transaction comparables
• Experience managing transaction processes and coordinating multiple workstreams simultaneously
• Experience reviewing and providing quality control over financial analyses and client deliverables
• Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
• Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
• High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
• Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

Investment Banking Services are offered through Triple P Securities, LLC. Member

Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job: People Partner

Location: United States, Remote 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our People Partner is a strategic advisor and catalyst for organizational effectiveness. Rather than simply managing HR transactions, you will partner directly with business leaders to align talent strategies with our overarching business objectives. You will act as a trusted coach, a change agent, and a data-driven problem solver who ensures our teams are structured, supported, and engaged to drive consistent growth. While you will oversee complex employee relations, your true impact will be felt in your ability to proactively identify organizational gaps and implement initiatives that elevate our high-performance culture.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Partner with department leaders to design and execute talent strategies, including workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers, building their capability to lead high-performing, highly engaged teams.

• Analyze workforce trends and metrics to recommend action plans that improve engagement and retention.

• Lead change management initiatives to support business transformation, scale, and continuous improvement across your dedicated client groups.

• Oversee complex employee relations matters, including investigations, ensuring fairness, risk mitigation, and alignment with our core values.

• Lead the creation and maintenance of company policies, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and company direction.

• Craft corporate communications that land clearly across all levels of the organization.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will have the opportunity to shape the employee experience for a fast-growing team. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a strategic, commercially-minded HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the success of their peers. You excel at looking beyond the symptoms of an organizational issue to diagnose root causes, and you are comfortable challenging leaders with empathy and data. You do not just manage processes; you drive outcomes.

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming our People Partner is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft People Business Partner team is a small but mighty group of strategic advisors embedded with the business. We partner with leaders on organizational design, manager capability, and workforce planning, and we turn people data into action so our teams can perform at their best.

As a People Partner, you'll help bring our five core values to life across the business: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, and Customer-Inspired. They shape how we hire, coach, and grow our people every day.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

• 7+ years of professional experience in Human Resources, with a strong background as an HRBP, People Partner, or equivalent strategic role.

• Demonstrated experience in coaching business leaders, driving organizational design, and leading change management initiatives.

• Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a high-demand environment with professionalism and good judgment

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience interfacing with all levels of an organization

• High attention to detail and a high degree of empathy in supporting a positive, accommodating employee experience

• Bachelor's Degree

Preferred:

• Experience supporting technical or go-to-market teams in a high-growth SaaS environment.

• Advanced proficiency in leveraging HRIS data to build compelling, data-driven business cases.

• A passion for teamwork and contributing to the success and reputation of the broader People function.

• Prior experience in a PE backed organization preferred.

2a87f8780fecdfc5.description: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at [bitwarden.com](http://bitwarden.com). As a Lead Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, you will lead the design and development of our next-generation privileged access platform. You'll own critical gateway services, terminal access protocols, and auditing/enforcement at the intersection of security, scalability, and user experience. In alignment with our modern **True Ownership** model, our engineers are "T-shaped" professionals who own their services end-to-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production. This role offers unique opportunities to build secure-by-default patterns and make significant contributions to our open-source security ecosystem. **RESPONSIBILITIES** - **End-to-End Delivery:** Support Bitwarden goals by designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, performant gateway controls, audited terminal logins, and session recording mechanics for our PAM product line. - **Decoupled Architecture:** Maintain strict service boundaries and design resilient APIs that allow the PAM platform to operate as an independent, decoupled tenant on our core platform infrastructure. - **Upstream Collaboration:** Partner closely in a co-located, cross-functional "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to rapidly design and validate technical solutions prior to code implementation. - **Automated Quality:** Eliminate manual testing barriers by building and maintaining robust automated test suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines for your team's services. - **Operational Stewardship:** Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production, proactively participating in sustainable on-call rotations and postmortem analyses. - **Documentation:** Build and maintain high-quality internal architecture specifications, API contracts, and external open-source developer documentation. **WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN** - **Overall Experience: 8+ years** as a Lead Software Engineer with team lead experience paired with AI assisted development practices, including experience leading a team's technical direction, mentoring senior engineers and being accountable for outcomes you did not implement yourself. - **Quality:** Experience with JEST or any other unit testing framework. Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them. - **Technical Stack:**Strong proficiency and experience in AI-Led Development in C# / .NET, Rust, or TypeScript. - **Security Domain Expertise:** Practical experience designing or implementing secure gateway architectures, reverse proxies, and session proxying (SSH, RDP, or HTTPS). - **Identity & Auditing:** Understanding of Identity and Access Management, key-rotation protocols, and real-time audit logging systems. - **T-Shaped Engineering Mindset:** Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards). - **Secure Coding:** Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards and threat-modeling methodologies. - **Collaborative Spirit:** A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. - **Open Source Passion:** Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. - **Problem-Solving:** Excellent problem-solving skills—valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. ## **Why Join Us** This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. ## **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
